[1/3] Quarantine unreadable local state files instead of crashing at login

impact_assessment.why: A truncated or corrupt personnel_db_<user>.json or users_db.json raises JSONDecodeError inside load_db/load_users, so the app cannot start for that user and the corrupt file is never recovered
impact_assessment.benefits: Login and state restore fall back to empty defaults while the corrupt file is preserved for inspection, matching the PRINCIPLE-013 corrupt-state contract already used by the scheduler/ledger
impact_assessment.risks: contract: storage gains one reader used by load_db and load_users; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: same single-writer atomic model; state: corrupt file renamed to <name>.corrupt_<epoch>
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests for valid, missing, and corrupt files plus AppTest proof, full gates, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Unreadable personnel and users JSON is renamed to .corrupt_<epoch> and defaults are returned; three unit tests plus AppTest proof; checklists: passed (test 41, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)
Task 'corrupt-state-quarantine' completed successfully.
[1/3] Give exported calendar events a readable month-scoped title

impact_assessment.why: The ICS export derives its title with t['title'].split(' ')[0], which keeps only the leading emoji, so every exported event is titled '🧙‍♂️ Duty' regardless of language
impact_assessment.benefits: Calendar clients show a meaningful monthly roster title in both languages
impact_assessment.risks: contract: main passes a helper-derived title instead of the emoji; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first helper tests for both languages and fallback, AppTest proof of the ICS path, full gates, explicit staging, no push

[1/3] Replace the deprecated use_container_width parameter with width='stretch'

impact_assessment.why: Streamlit warns on every rerun that use_container_width will be removed after 2025-12-31; the installed release supports the width= API for buttons, download buttons, dataframes and the data editor
impact_assessment.benefits: No deprecation noise and no breakage when the old parameter is removed
impact_assessment.risks: contract: requires a Streamlit release with width= (requirements stay unpinned and resolves current); dependency: none beyond that; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Global replace verified by count, AppTest generate and export flow, full gates, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [2/3] All 20 deprecated use_container_width sites now use width='stretch'; AppTest generate/ICS flow clean and no deprecation warnings; checklists: passed (test 44, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)
Task 'streamlit-width-migration' completed successfully.
[1/3] Keep runtime-downloaded PDF fonts out of the tracked tree

impact_assessment.why: generate_pdf downloads Roboto-Regular.ttf and Roboto-Bold.ttf into the project root on first PDF export; they are untracked and not ignored, so a normal export dirties the worktree and risks committing ~1 MB of binary assets
impact_assessment.benefits: PDF export no longer makes the repository look modified, and generated fonts cannot be committed accidentally
impact_assessment.risks: contract: .gitignore only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: generated cache files stay local
impact_assessment.mitigation: Ignore the generated names, verify with git check-ignore and the hygiene gate, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Roboto-*.ttf is ignored; git check-ignore confirms both generated fonts; hygiene, guidelines and secrets gates pass; checklists: passed (test 44, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)
Task 'font-artifact-hygiene' completed successfully.
[1/3] Clear the in-session roster when a loaded database has none

impact_assessment.why: load_cloud_data only restores generated_schedule when the database contains one, so loading a database without a roster keeps the previous roster active, displayed against the new personnel and persisted by the next Save
impact_assessment.benefits: Loading a database always yields a state consistent with that database
impact_assessment.risks: contract: load resets generated_schedule, schedule_success, gen_year and gen_month before the optional restore; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: session widget/state keys only
impact_assessment.mitigation: AppTest reproduction before and after, full gates, explicit staging, no push
